# Kawaki Studios
> Custom Web Development, Shopify Development, AI Automation, AI Search Optimization, and Security Services.

Kawaki Studios (https://www.kawaki.co.in) is an independent digital engineering studio founded by Kunal Sharma. We engineer custom web applications, bespoke Shopify storefronts, automation workflows, AI search architecture, and WordPress security recovery for businesses globally.

## Core Services & Architecture
- [Custom Web Development](https://www.kawaki.co.in/services/custom-web-development): Full-stack custom web applications, Next.js architecture, TypeScript engineering, semantic frontends, and API integrations.
- [Shopify Development](https://www.kawaki.co.in/services/shopify-development): Custom Liquid theme development, headless Shopify architectures, Storefront API integrations, and platform migrations.
- [AI Automation](https://www.kawaki.co.in/services/ai-automation): Practical workflow automation, deterministic webhook pipelines, n8n and Make orchestration, and task-specific AI agents.
- [AI Search Optimization](https://www.kawaki.co.in/services/ai-search-optimization): Technical search engineering, entity architecture, Schema.org structured data, and content discoverability across search engines and AI assistants.
- [WordPress Malware Removal](https://www.kawaki.co.in/services/wordpress-malware-removal): Hacked site recovery, malicious script isolation, database cleanup, backdoor investigation, and security hardening.
- [Engineering Standards](https://www.kawaki.co.in/services): Core Web Vitals optimization, clean semantic markup, strict asset budgeting, and production-grade deployment workflows.
